DataVerse X 1.0 – Data Visualization Challenge

Event Overview:

DataVerse X 1.0, organized by Bizlytics Club at Chandigarh University, is a competition designed to encourage students to apply their knowledge of Data Science, Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning to real-world problems. The event aims to promote analytical thinking, creativity, data storytelling, and the effective use of visualization techniques to transform raw data into meaningful insights.

Eligibility Criteria:

  • The competition is open to students interested in Data Science, Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Data Visualization.
  • Students from different specializations are encouraged to participate.
  • Inter-college participation and team composition will be governed by the official registration guidelines issued by the organizers.

Competition Format:

The competition will consist of two rounds:

Round 1: PPT Submission:

  • Participants must prepare and submit a PowerPoint presentation showcasing their proposed solution, data analysis, visualization approach, and key insights relevant to the competition theme.
  • The PPT must clearly explain the problem statement, methodology, visualizations, findings, and potential real-world applications.
  • Submission deadline: 19 September 2026, at 11:59 PM.
  • Submissions received after the deadline may not be considered for evaluation.
  • Entries will be evaluated based on relevance, analytical approach, creativity, visualization quality, and clarity of presentation.
  • Shortlisted participants or teams will qualify for Round 2.

Round 2: Offline Competition

  • The second round will be conducted offline at Chandigarh University, Punjab.
  • Shortlisted participants or teams will present and demonstrate their solutions before the evaluation panel.
  • Participants must explain their approach, data visualization techniques, findings, and the practical significance of their solutions.
  • The final results will be determined by the judges based on the announced evaluation criteria.

Rules and Regulations:

  • Participants must complete the registration process within the prescribed timeline.
  • All PPT submissions must be original and submitted before the deadline.
  • Plagiarism, copied submissions, and misrepresentation of data or results may lead to disqualification.
  • Participants must acknowledge external datasets, tools, and resources wherever applicable.
  • Participants must follow the instructions and schedule communicated by the organizing committee.
  • Shortlisting for Round 2 will be based on the evaluation of Round 1 submissions.
  • Participants qualifying for Round 2 must attend the offline round at Chandigarh University.
  • The decision of the judging panel and organizing committee will be final.

Evaluation Criteria:

  • Problem identification and relevance.
  • Data analysis and interpretation.
  • Creativity and originality.
  • Quality and clarity of visualizations.
  • Practical applicability of the proposed solution.
  • Presentation and communication skills.

Expected Outcomes:

  • DataVerse X 1.0 aims to enhance participants' practical knowledge of data visualization, strengthen analytical and problem-solving skills, and encourage the development of innovative, data-driven solutions to real-world challenges. The event will also provide a platform for students to showcase their technical abilities, creativity, and presentation skills.
